readerQuestion: Does a better AI protein-model benchmark mean a new medicine is on the way?
sourceBoundEvent: Nature reports a consortium trained a proprietary OpenFold3-derived model on more than 20,000 structures; its described evaluation is not peer reviewed and the model is not public.
readerPayoff: A bounded explanation can show why research-data access and a model benchmark are different from a new drug or treatment.
limits: No claim of a drug discovery, treatment benefit, public availability or peer-reviewed evaluation.
Do not turn a reported benchmark into patient advice.
nextAction: Producer may prepare a contract only if this data-access mechanism has enough beginner payoff for a short research article; otherwise retain as an evidence-complete research brief.
